title: feat(nm2hol2yz): 2x1 yz rectangle cyclic-frame holonomy at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: 2x1 yz rectangle holonomy, column convention. Fails at the vertex gate on both loops: H=(0,2,1) has O={-e_2} and C,C1,C4 have degenerate splits. Also reports transport/Orient/split/cover = hold/hold while holonomy and scalar = fail/fail on the same state. DEFECT: its theorem1-M-O-split / theorem1-Orient / theorem1-transport gates use labels A,B,C,D for a DIFFERENT quadruple ((0,0,1),(1,1,1),(0,0,2),(1,0,1), inherited boilerplate from the earlier z-probe band) than the A,B,C,D naming the rectangle vertices in the same log — a name collision that makes the log self-contradictory on Orient(A).
